name: FamiliesTips
description: Clan Primer Traveler's Tips: four ungated 'Weapon Families' tips carrying the per-family identity text (0.1.35 wording, 0.1.6 layout: a yellow heading per family trait, indented text, blank lines between entries, yellow cross-references) (moved off weapon help; that runtime feature is reverted separately). Extends the deployed 17-entry state: the 16 native tips plus the Proficiency tip. Titles go into penelosdiary rows 654-657 (IDs 0x16E0-0x16E3), found empty and unreferenced the same way row 661 was. Flag 255 writes check byte 2 = 0xFF, the format's own no-flag-test convention, so the game shows these tips unconditionally. 0.1.7: Reckless reworded for R1 (damage taken, not Defense). 0.1.8: Reckless raises physical hits only. 0.1.9: the Clan Primer refresh (defines Broken and Staggered; Reckless, ninja sword dodge, Pierce while Brave, Channel, True aim interrupt, foes tire). 0.1.10: every axe hit Breaks and the dents stop at half; Broken is an ailment for job and hybrid triggers, not for gambits; the 5 s Regen guard is an ally's; rare game shares the smaller push limit. 0.1.11: text clarity pass (full sentences instead of clipped fragments; Broken and Staggered defined in plain words; no clause-colons; Hammer chance and Spear/Pierce wording simplified; the Spear "still blocks and dodges" note dropped to fit the page). 0.1.12 (2026-11-16, Marco: downsides, never punishments): Reckless, Braced, Open and the rod Lure are gone from the text; the greatsword sweep (full on the aimed foe, half of that on the rest), the sword, katana, spear, rod, axe, dagger and gun lines state their new downsides; the armor floors, the 30 percent counter parry and Counter Boost on a pole are stated; Broken lists a Warrior at low HP. 0.1.13 (2026-11-17): rebuilt on the Proficiency tip that now defines Leech; only the source pin of the pages file and the result pin changed, the four tips are as in 0.1.12. 0.1.14 (2026-11-17): the Leech paragraph of the Proficiency tip states that a counter leeches its own share (source pin of the pages file and result pin only). 0.1.15 (2026-11-17): the Leech paragraph of the Proficiency tip words the counter and hit-taken share (source pin of the pages file and result pin only). 0.1.16 (2026-11-17, gear and items audit): the Sword line no longer claims the best weapon evade of any family (shop swords run 17 to 38, poles 25 to 30 and the Main Gauche has 40); the Hammer line names the Scorpion Tail's 20 percent Disable.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Heavy
tips.body:
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Greatsword: Sweep{/}
  An attack hits its target in full and every foe around
  it for half of that hit. It is slow, most cannot reach
  flying foes, and an axe or a spear does more against a
  lone armored foe.

{y}Axe: Sunder{/}
  Every hit {y}Breaks{/} the foe and dents its Defense 5
  percent of its start, twice as deep on a {y}Staggered{/}
  foe, down to half. The Breaks go on after that. Swings
  land unevenly and the axe barely parries.

{y}Hammer: Concussion{/}
  Hits Disable 15 percent of the time, 20 on Scorpion
  Tail, and knock it back 30 percent. The swing is slow.

{y}Spear: Pierce{/}
  Every hit ignores 30 percent of Defense, and a Brave
  wielder also {y}Breaks{/} the foe. Most spears cannot parry.

{y}Broken and Staggered{/}
  A foe is Broken for 10 seconds after Sunder, Expose,
  Shear, a Brave spear, a Faithful staff or a Warrior at
  low HP cuts it open. Proficiency counts it, gambits do
  not. A Staggered foe's charge is pushed to the limit.

{y}Armor: Softening{/}
  Heavy armor softens a blow by up to half, light by up
  to 40 percent and mystic by up to 30, unless your
  other Defense already softens it more than that.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Light
tips.body:
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Sword: Guard{/}
  Most swords carry high evade, 17 to 38, so a sword
  wielder parries often. A sword has no answer to armor
  or to a foe's evasion.

{y}Katana: Chain{/}
  The highest combo rate of any family, and a combo runs
  one hit longer. Every combo hit meets the foe's full
  Defense, and a katana leaves no hand for a shield.

{y}Ninja Sword: Unseen{/}
  Hits cannot be parried or blocked, and a foe that is
  Slowed, Immobilized, Stopped or tired cannot dodge
  them. Every blade has a 10 percent chance to Blind on
  hit, and some add a second status.

{y}Dagger: Swift{/}
  The fastest charge, frequent combos and a little
  evade.

{y}Dagger and Ninja Sword: Glancing{/}
  Against a heavily armored foe, hits fall to an eighth
  of the attack, not a quarter.

{y}Fists: Cadence{/}
  Each attack in a row on one foe hits 6 percent harder,
  up to 30 percent, and quickens your next action. A
  full streak counts as a counter for {y}Ki Flow{/}. Switching
  foes restarts the ramp.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Ranged
tips.body:
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Bow: Volley{/}
  Bows have the keenest critical chance among the ranged
  weapons.

{y}Crossbow: Afflict{/}
  The bolt's status chance is doubled, up to 100
  percent. Bolts take a little longer to load.

{y}Gun: True aim{/}
  A gunner's shots never miss, Blind or not, and ignore
  Defense. Strength does not raise them, and a gun is
  the slowest weapon to charge. A shot at a foe whose
  charge is three quarters full pushes it back 10
  percent. The party's pushes stop at 25 percent of the
  charge a turn, 12.5 for bosses, marks and rare game,
  and the foe is {y}Staggered{/}.

{y}Hand-bomb: Barrage{/}
  The bombs you load decide the status, which lands with
  a 25 percent chance on hit. Chaos Bombs, which
  Confuse, and Stun Bombs, which Stop, set up a Time
  Mage's {y}Detonate{/}.

{y}Every weapon: Tiring{/}
  Each attack a fighter avoids in a row leaves it 25
  percent less evasion against the next, up to four. A
  hit that lands, or 10 seconds without an attack, 5 for
  an ally with Regen, makes it fresh. A Blind attacker
  never tires it. A counter always gets a parry chance
  of at least 30 percent, except for fists.

tips.title: Weapon Families: Magick
tips.body:
No license is needed for these traits.

{y}Rod: Mend{/}
  Healing spells heal 20 percent more while a rod is
  held. Potions are unchanged. A rod has the weakest
  attack and the least Magick of the caster weapons.

{y}Staff: Channel{/}
  Staves raise element potency and give the most Magick
  of the caster weapons. While you hold Faith, each
  damage spell that lands {y}Breaks{/} the foe. Proficiency
  counts Broken as an ailment, but gambits do not.

{y}Mace: Spellbreak{/}
  Hits burn MP equal to 10 percent of the damage, and
  never more than 10 percent of the foe's pool.

{y}Measure: Tempo{/}
  Each measure grants one status to the ally it strikes,
  which is Protect, Shell, Bravery, Invisible, Haste or
  Bubble depending on the tier.

{y}Pole: Counterflow{/}
  You counter even without the {y}Counter{/} augment, which
  the {y}Battle Harness{/} and {y}Magepower Shishak{/} carry, and
  twice as often with it. Counter Boost quadruples the
  chance either way. Blows taken build the next counter,
  and the pole strikes Magick Resist. Its evade is 25 to
  30, so its counters can swing.
